layout.subtitle: Manage your account, player profile, and creator profile in one place.

meta.title: Notification settings
meta.description: Choose which events appear in your inbox

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Choose which events appear in your inbox. Browser notifications follow these inbox settings.
notifications.pushHint: Uses the same type and category switches as your inbox.
notifications.pushDenied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings to receive alerts.
notifications.pushUnsupported: This browser does not support notifications.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.subtitle: Site options that apply to your account on this device.

submissionMinimalMotion.label: Minimal motion on submission page
submissionMinimalMotion.description: Turns off decorative animations on the submission landing page. Character hover glow stays so you can still tell which side is active. Also applied automatically when your system requests reduced motion.

disableMascots.label: Disable mascots
disableMascots.description: Hides character art on the submission landing page and shows Adofai / creator icons instead.

cycle.label: Cycle through links (default)
cycle.description: Clicking a navbar section goes to its first page, then the next page on each click. The menu stays open so you can see the current page. It closes after 5 seconds, or sooner if you move the pointer away, and the next click starts at the first page again.

pin.label: Pin menu open
pin.description: Clicking a navbar section pins the dropdown open without navigating. Pick a page from the menu.

publicFollows.label: Show me on other people's follower lists
publicFollows.description: Toggles whether you're shown on the follower lists. When off, you'll be shown as "Hidden follower" along others with this option.
publicFollows.error: Could not update follower list visibility

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.subtitle: Devices currently signed in to your account. Sign out anything you do not recognize.
sessions.revokeError: Could not sign out that session
sessions.revokeOthersConfirm: Sign out all other devices? This device will stay signed in.
sessions.revokeOthersError: Could not sign out other devices

trustedDevices.title: Trusted devices
trustedDevices.subtitle: Devices that skip 2 factor authentication (2FA). Revoke any you do not recognize.
trustedDevices.revokeError: Could not remove that trusted device

oauthApps.title: Authorized apps
oauthApps.subtitle: Third-party apps and mods that can access your TUF profile. Revoke access anytime.
